title: Self-Supervised Learning of Parametric Approximation for Security-Constrained DC-OPF
summary: This paper introduces a self-supervised learning framework for approximating the Security-Constrained DC Optimal Power Flow (SC-DCOPF) problem using a parametric linear model. The approach preserves the physical structure of the DC-OPF while incorporating demand-dependent tunable parameters that scale transmission line limits. These parameters are predicted via a Graph Neural Network and optimized through differentiable layers, enabling direct training from contingency costs without requiring labeled data.
